title: Post-stay review request
description: Ask guests for a review after checkout with a one-tap link. Marketing WhatsApp template for hotels, hostels and rentals.
notes: Send the morning after checkout. Thank first, ask second, and avoid incentives that breach review-site rules.

body.text: Thank you for staying with us, {{first_name}}! We hope you enjoyed your time at {{hotel}}. Would you share a quick review? It takes less than a minute and helps future guests.
